findings.issue_summary: App handles user accounts, but the deletion mechanism is a partial deletion trap.
findings.evidence: In /home/shaolin/lyria/shared/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/musically/studio/ui/MainViewModel.kt at line 849 and /home/shaolin/lyria/src/web/features/auth/DeleteAccountScreen.tsx at line 27, the code triggers a standard Firebase auth user deletion but fails to send a remote network API call to clean up the backend user records stored in the Firestore 'users' collection (created in /home/shaolin/lyria/src/routes/auth.ts).
findings.recommendation: Implement in-app deletion: Expand the in-app deletion process to completely wipe remote database records (e.g. Firestore user document), not just sign out or delete the Firebase Auth credential.
